user.title: Connect to the Siemens OZW672
user.description: Enter the connection details of the OZW672 web server.

device.title: Select the plant device
device.description: The OZW672 reports the devices it is wired to. Select the controller to use. Datapoint identifiers are generated for the plant, so the selection identifies this installation in Home Assistant.

datapoints.title: Datapoints of your installation
datapoints.description:
A datapoint is identified by its topic in the controller and not by its numeric identifier: the OZW672 generates the identifiers for the plant it is wired to, and they change when the plant or the server parameters are refreshed. The identifier is checked again on every reload.

Add the datapoints you want to use, then finish.

menu_options.add_by_id: Add a datapoint by its id

add_datapoints.title: Add datapoints
add_datapoints.description: The datapoints of the plant are browsed one topic after the other, exactly as in the menu tree of the OZW672. Each screen lists the datapoints of one topic: tick the ones you want, then continue.

add_by_id.title: Add a datapoint by its id
add_by_id.description: Enter the numeric identifier of a datapoint of the OZW672 menutree. Its description is read on the device: the type, the unit, the range and the enumeration values decide whether the datapoint becomes a read only sensor or an entity that can be changed from Home Assistant. The identifier can be changed by the controller when the plant is refreshed; if it belongs to the menu tree of the plant its topic is stored as well, so it is re-resolved automatically on every reload.

pick.title: Select the datapoints
pick.description:
Topic {index}/{total}: {topic}

The datapoints you ticked earlier stay ticked when you come back. Writable numeric datapoints become numbers, the others become sensors; the entity type can be changed afterwards in the options.

topic_menu.title: Datapoints of this topic stored
topic_menu.description: Everything ticked so far is kept. Continue with the next topic, go back to the previous one, or finish the selection.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the OZW672
reauth_confirm.description: The OZW672 rejected the stored credentials. Update them below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the OZW672.
error.no_datapoints: No datapoint was found on this device. Check that the OZW672 is wired to a controller and that the plant is online.
error.unknown_datapoint: This datapoint identifier could not be read on the OZW672. Check the identifier in the device web interface.

backup.title: Save the selection to a file
backup.description:
The {count} datapoints of this installation are listed below as JSON. Copy the whole text and save it in a file, for example `siemens_ozw672_datapoints.json`. Keep it somewhere safe: restoring it later saves you from selecting the datapoints again, for instance after a clean installation of Home Assistant.

The connection details are not included, so the file is safe to keep next to a backup of your configuration.

restore.title: Restore a selection from a file
restore.description:
Paste the content of a file saved with 'Save the selection to a file'. The datapoints already configured ({count}) are replaced by the ones of the file.

The identifiers are written down again from the topics when the entry reloads, so a selection saved on another installation is accepted: the names, the entity types, the units, the ranges and the enumeration options all come from the file.
